name: Roberto Soldic
summary: Former two-division KSW champion and a knockout artist (18 KO/TKO wins) making his UFC debut; power puncher with championship experience, coming off a first-round KO in February 2025.

how_they_fight.Defense & durability: Has been stopped (Kadestam, 2023); chin is good but not untouchable.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced in big fights; the unknown is his first UFC fight and its adrenaline.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Can wrestle but prefers to strike; his ONE run (2022-23) included a KO loss to Zebaztian Kadestam and a no contest.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: About 20 months out of the cage before this debut.
how_they_fight.Striking: Heavy, compact power punching and aggressive finishing instincts; beat Mamed Khalidov by knockout in 2021.

concerns: Fighting a fast starter with his own power
keys_to_beat: Beat him to the punch early
Make it a technical, long fight
